annotations.title: Read one card's price series, sales and asks

description: Read ONE Magic printing's stored daily price series, its recent sales and its current TCGplayer asks. Every caller gets all three, signed in or not. tcgplayerProductId is the exact printing's TCGplayer product id when known. series has one point per stored day, oldest first: priceUsd is the TCGplayer Market price SpellBook stored that day and tcgLow is the TCGplayer Low price. buckets sums Near Mint and Lightly Played sales of the requested finish with English or unspecified language by the exact raw bucketStartDate values returned by TCGplayer. The source response does not establish each bucket's duration or end date. Each row has units, transactions, a units-weighted bucket market and the lowest and highest recorded sale. If qualifying sold rows have unspecified language, limitations says so; known non-English rows are excluded. bucketsState distinguishes no stored fetch from an observed fetch; bucketsCoverage gives the first and last stored bucket dates when available. asks lists the TCGplayer listings of the requested finish from the newest unexpired snapshot, cheapest first, with item price, condition, language when known, listing shipping when known, quantity and seller name. asksTotal and asksTruncated report the source row count and truncation status when known. Each evidence family carries its own captured time. Call it after spellbook_printings_search names the printing, to see how its price moved over weeks or to compare its market series with recent sales and asks. Call spellbook_card_prices for today's price from every other source. It returns observations and limitations; it does not rank or recommend a printing. Compute any band, return or range yourself from series. Each TCGplayer product id carries tcgplayerBuyUrl, a short SpellBook Finance affiliate link to that TCGplayer page. Say it is an affiliate link when you share it.

cardId.description: The exact Magic printing id (a Scryfall UUID) from spellbook_printings_search. Required.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

finish.description: Which finish to read. Omit for nonfoil. Pass foil for a foil copy, because SpellBook stores foil prices, sales and asks apart from nonfoil.
